status: APPROVED DEVELOPMENT PROFILE PROPOSAL — REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL
proposal_authority: new schema decisions authorized by the 2026-08-07 human request; not derived values from F1-F119

scalar_types.enum: uint from the named approved registry
scalar_types.canonical_name: UTF-8 tstr, NFC, lowercase A-label form, 1..255 encoded bytes
scalar_types.request_event_object_id: bstr .size 16; unique inside issuer domain; bytewise equality only

DelegationScope.cardinality: all 11 keys required; null means constrained dimension not applicable, never wildcard
DelegationScope.canonical_ordering: map integer key order; arrays sorted lexicographically and duplicate-free; port ranges disjoint, ascending, and non-adjacent
DelegationScope.intersection: fieldwise intersection; null intersects only null; child must equal or narrow every dimension

FederationDependencySet.canonical_ordering: ascending object_class then bytewise digest; duplicate tuple rejected
FederationDependencySet.digest: SHA-256 over deterministic CBOR encoding of the complete array

ExtensionEntry.canonical_ordering: outer extension IDs ascending; entry integer key order
ExtensionEntry.preservation: unknown non-critical canonical_value bytes preserved exactly; unknown critical rejected

SignatureReference.canonical_ordering: authority_class, purpose, kid, COSE digest, payload digest; duplicates rejected

OrganizationBinding.cardinality: exactly one of public_name/domain_commitment non-null according to mode

LifecycleTransition.cardinality: exactly four keys; recovery_stage non-null iff to_state=RECOVERY

OperatorRegistryRecord.rationale: Durable registry authority and lifecycle state changes over time.

fields.name: organization_binding
fields.bounds: closed map; public or private-domain mode

fields.name: revocation_reference
fields.bounds: null means explicitly no accepted revocation; otherwise one target

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state

KeyAuthorizationRecord.rationale: Purpose-bound key authority rotates and recovers through durable continuity.

fields.name: key_id
fields.bounds: 1..64 bytes; immutable within a generation; never reused after terminal state

fields.name: public_key
fields.bounds: exactly 32-byte Ed25519 public key; immutable within a generation

fields.name: revocation_reference
fields.bounds: required target when revocation_state=true; explicit null otherwise

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state
new_generation.evidence: accepted RecoveryTransitionRecord binding operator, key purpose, scope, old and new generation

NameOwnershipRecord.rationale: Durable ownership authority supports transfer and recovery.

fields.name: owner_reference
fields.bounds: one public or privacy-safe owner reference

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state

DelegationRecord.rationale: Mutable scoped authority must retain ancestry and narrowing continuity.

fields.name: parent_digest
fields.genesis: forbidden for ownership-root delegation; required for child

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state
new_generation.evidence: accepted RecoveryTransitionRecord; ordinary generation change cannot widen scope

FederationTrustBundle.rationale: Trust roots, logs, witnesses, and thresholds are durable mutable trust state.

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state
new_generation.evidence: 4-of-5 governance plus 3-of-5 witnesses or accepted scoped recovery transition

TransparencyCheckpoint.rationale: A signed tree snapshot uses log generation and checkpoint sequence; continuity is tree consistency, not object predecessor lineage.

fields.name: previous_checkpoint_digest
fields.bounds: null for size 0; exact 32 bytes otherwise

same_generation_update.reason: each checkpoint is a new immutable snapshot; next checkpoint has higher sequence and a consistency proof

new_generation.evidence: log recovery/governance transition and last checkpoint continuity or explicit break

InclusionProof.rationale: One-shot Merkle evidence derives freshness and continuity from its checkpoint.

new_generation.reason: new evidence/state creates a new object digest

ConsistencyProof.rationale: One-shot consistency evidence derives continuity from its two checkpoints.

new_generation.reason: new evidence/state creates a new object digest

WitnessStatement.rationale: A replay-bound signed observation is never updated in place.

new_generation.reason: new evidence/state creates a new object digest

OperatorEndpointRecord.rationale: Federation-facing endpoint publication rotates while preserving operator continuity.

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state

FederationAuthorityProof.rationale: A derived authority proof is replaced by a new digest whenever dependency state changes.

fields.name: source_operator_id
fields.bounds: null for unilateral; exact 32 bytes for bilateral

new_generation.reason: new evidence/state creates a new object digest

FederationAuthorizationContext.rationale: Immutable bilateral authorization is replaced whenever any dependency or policy changes.

new_generation.reason: new authorization is a separate context ID and digest

TypedRevocationRecord.rationale: Revocation authority is durable, monotonic, and must preserve replacement history.

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state
new_generation.evidence: higher generation only for separately authorized replacement; terminal target never resurrects

ConflictEvidence.rationale: Evidence is append-only; additions create a new evidence object under the conflict ID.

new_generation.reason: new evidence/state creates a new object digest

OperatorLifecycleRecord.rationale: Registry lifecycle authority is durable and gates all operator authority.

fields.name: recovery_stage
fields.genesis: required only when lifecycle_state=RECOVERY; forbidden otherwise
fields.update: required only when lifecycle_state=RECOVERY; forbidden otherwise

same_generation_update.previous_digest: required and equals immediately accepted canonical digest

new_generation.previous_digest: required and equals prior terminal or transition-authorized state
new_generation.evidence: accepted RecoveryTransitionRecord plus registry and witness approval

RecoveryTransitionRecord.rationale: A one-shot recovery authorization binds old/new generations and cannot represent ordinary rotation.

fields.name: continuity_digest
fields.bounds: exact 32 bytes or null only with explicit_break=true

new_generation.reason: a later recovery uses a new transition ID and strictly higher affected generation

ConflictResolutionRecord.rationale: A signed resolution is immutable; later process creates a separately identified decision.

fields.name: previous_decision_digest
fields.bounds: null or exact 32 bytes; only sequential review

new_generation.reason: new resolution has a new decision ID; previous_decision_digest only for explicit sequential review

AppealDecisionRecord.rationale: An appeal result is immutable and cannot itself restore unsafe authority.

fields.name: previous_decision_digest
fields.bounds: null or exact 32 bytes; only sequential review

new_generation.reason: later review creates a new decision ID and optionally binds the prior decision
